mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.avatar, d.dept_name AS deptName FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.user_id != #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_menu permission_menu ON permission_menu.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND permission_menu.perms = 'system:chat' AND permission_menu.status = '0' )
AND (u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
${scope.params.dataScope} ORDER BY u.nick_name, u.user_id LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_menu permission_menu ON permission_menu.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND permission_menu.perms = 'system:chat' AND permission_menu.status = '0' ) AND u.user_id IN #{id} ${scope.params.dataScope}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_menu permission_menu ON permission_menu.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND permission_menu.perms = 'system:chat' AND permission_menu.status = '0' ) ${scope.params.dataScope}

SELECT c.conversation_id AS conversationId, c.type, CASE WHEN c.type = 'D' THEN peer.nick_name ELSE c.name END AS name, CASE WHEN c.type = 'D' THEN peer.avatar ELSE '' END AS avatar, c.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, c.last_message_id AS lastMessageId, c.last_message_preview AS lastMessagePreview, c.last_message_time AS lastMessageTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message unread WHERE unread.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND unread.message_id > COALESCE(cm.last_read_message_id, 0) AND unread.sender_user_id != #{userId} AND unread.deleted_flag = '0') AS unreadCount FROM chat_conversation_member cm JOIN chat_conversation c ON c.conversation_id = cm.conversation_id AND c.status = '0' LEFT JOIN chat_conversation_member peer_member ON c.type = 'D' AND peer_member.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND peer_member.user_id != #{userId} AND peer_member.left_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_user peer ON peer.user_id = peer_member.user_id WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(c.last_message_time, c.create_time) DESC, c.conversation_id DESC
SELECT conversation_id FROM chat_conversation WHERE direct_key = #{directKey} AND type = 'D' AND status = '0' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_conversation (type, direct_key, name, owner_user_id, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{type}, #{directKey}, #{name}, #{ownerUserId}, '0', NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO chat_conversation_member (conversation_id, user_id, role, joined_at, left_at, last_read_message_id, mute_flag) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{role}, NOW(), NULL, 0, '0') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role = VALUES(role), joined_at = NOW(), left_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_conversation_member cm JOIN chat_conversation c ON c.conversation_id = cm.conversation_id AND c.status = '0' WHERE cm.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL

SELECT m.message_id AS messageId, m.conversation_id AS conversationId, m.sender_user_id AS senderUserId, u.nick_name AS senderName, u.avatar, m.client_message_id AS clientMessageId, m.message_type AS messageType, m.content, m.create_time AS createTime FROM chat_message m JOIN chat_conversation c ON c.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND c.status = '0' JOIN chat_conversation_member viewer ON viewer.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND viewer.user_id = #{userId} AND viewer.left_at IS NULL JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = m.sender_user_id WHERE m.message_id = #{messageId} AND m.deleted_flag = '0'

SELECT message_id AS messageId, conversation_id AS conversationId, sender_user_id AS senderUserId, client_message_id AS clientMessageId, message_type AS messageType, content, create_time AS createTime FROM chat_message WHERE sender_user_id = #{senderUserId} AND client_message_id = #{clientMessageId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (conversation_id, sender_user_id, client_message_id, message_type, content, create_time, deleted_flag) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderUserId}, #{clientMessageId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, NOW(), '0')
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_conversation SET last_message_id = #{messageId}, last_message_preview = #{preview}, last_message_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND message_id = #{messageId} AND deleted_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_conversation_member SET last_read_message_id = GREATEST(last_read_message_id, #{messageId}), last_read_at = NOW() WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND left_at IS NULL
